analyzer.reason.noManifest: Missing: the extension has no manifest.json
analyzer.reason.manifestNotBuilt: Missing: the manifest is generated by the build and was not found in {path}; run the build first
analyzer.reason.noPolicy: Missing configuration: no declared permissions policy
analyzer.reason.policyUnparsable: Unavailable: the permissions policy {path} could not be read ({detail})
analyzer.reason.noTokens: Missing configuration: no declared design tokens reference
analyzer.reason.tokensUnreadable: Unavailable: the tokens reference {path} could not be read
analyzer.reason.tokensUnparsable: Unavailable: the tokens reference {path} could not be understood ({detail})
analyzer.reason.tokensFormat: Unavailable: the format of the tokens reference {path} is not supported
analyzer.reason.noBudgets: Missing configuration: no declared size budgets
analyzer.reason.noOutput: Unavailable: no build output in {path} to measure
analyzer.limits.manifest: Reads the extension's manifest without running it; it does not prove its behaviour
analyzer.limits.permissions: Compares the permissions with the declared policy; it does not prove a permission is used
analyzer.limits.refs: Checks the local references written out; paths computed at run time do not show
analyzer.limits.tokens: Reads the values written in the styles; computed values are the rendered check's
analyzer.limits.fonts: Reads the declared fonts and their definitions; it does not prove what renders
analyzer.limits.rtl: Reads the direction and the physical properties in the styles; it does not prove the rendering
analyzer.limits.size: Measures sizes against the budgets; a large size does not prove unused code
analyzer.limits.complexity: Maintenance indicators, as suggestions only; no finding without a threshold
